name: Red Shark POS
description: Big update: sales invoices, returns and delivery orders now keep stock, customer balance and cash correct (drafts and cancelled do nothing, cash refunds no longer also credit the customer, partial payments, choose the warehouse, invoice a delivery without taking stock twice). Proper VAT return. Payroll records salaries and deducts absences. New: cheque register, debt aging with WhatsApp reminders, installment plans, gift cards (usable at the POS), smart reorder, expiry control, L.L. rate history, loss-prevention alerts on the owner phone. New admin permissions for sensitive actions.
